page_title: FUL 2-1 LEI | Fulham v Leicester 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Jannik Vestergaard (Leicester) sees a yellow card from Darren Bond after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

90+4' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Bernd Leno, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
90+3' Harry Winks (Leicester) takes a direct free kick.
90+2' Darren Bond shows a yellow card to Tom Cairney (Fulham) for his blatant foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
86' Harrison Reed (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andreas Pereira.
85' Steven Cooper has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kasey McAteer (Leicester) replacing Victor Kristiansen.
83' The corner is swung in but Leicester can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' Leicester can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out for a corner. Leicester can continue in their attacking effort.
82' Marco Silva is stunned as referee Darren Bond shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
80' Here comes a substitution. Rodrigo Muniz is given a rest as he is replaced by Raul Jimenez (Fulham).
80' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
79' It seemed like Jordan Ayew (Leicester) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
78' Kenny Tete (Fulham) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Leicester will take a free kick near the side line.
72' The foul by Harry Wilson (Fulham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Darren Bond.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Facundo Buonanotte walks off the pitch to be replaced by Oliver Skipp (Leicester).
71' Substitution. Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) on for Jamie Vardy.
70' 2 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Alex Iwobi (Fulham) was set free in the area by Antonee Robinson and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 2:1.
69' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Tom Cairney (Fulham) replaces Adama Traore.
69' That will be all from Emile Smith Rowe who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Harry Wilson (Fulham).
67' Kenny Tete (Fulham) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.

66' Kenny Tete (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
64' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes a short free kick.
63' Bobby De Cordova-Reid goes off the pitch and Jordan Ayew (Leicester) comes on.
62' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Darren Bond blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham get a free kick.
62' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
61' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.
59' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Darren Bond ignores the protests.
57' Kenny Tete (Fulham) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
57' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
56' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
52' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
51' The referee blows his whistle, Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
51' Adama Traore (Fulham) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball is out of play. Fulham win a corner kick.
49' What a big chance! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
47' The resulting corner, taken by Andreas Pereira (Fulham), comes to nothing.

47' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+2' Looks like Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
44' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
41' Referee Darren Bond points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Leicester players celebrate.
39' The Leicester players halt their celebrations as referee Darren Bond makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
38' 1 - 1 Gooal! Facundo Buonanotte takes over corner duties. Wout Faes (Leicester) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the left side of the net. 1:1.
38' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
35' Leicester failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
33' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Leicester will take a corner kick.
33' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:2. The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
31' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
28' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) sends a low pass into the box, towards Rodrigo Muniz. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.

21' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.

18' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Adama Traore, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham), who beats Mads Hermansen with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 1:0.
17' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
12' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) commits a foul and Darren Bond immediately signals a free kick.
11' Wout Faes (Leicester) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
10' Harry Winks (Leicester) steps up to send the ball in.
10' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno makes a comfortable save. Leicester earn a corner.

8' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Alex Iwobi (Fulham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mads Hermansen pulls off a brilliant save.
5' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes a short corner kick.

4' Adama Traore (Fulham) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes an easy save. He should have scored that. The referee points to the corner flag and Fulham will take a corner.
3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Leicester will have the kick-off.
Darren Bond will referee today's match.
